summary: Bound server reads and stop cancelled blocking read work.

replay.detail: No claim replay or projection recovery changes. Read cancellation does not change frontier or projection health.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers or schema-version change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest change.

compatibility.detail: Reads return HTTP 504/read-deadline when the server budget expires: ordinary 15 seconds, long-poll envelopes add their configured wait (up to 30 seconds) to the 15-second read budget, with a separate 15-second query budget, and administrative bulk and doctor 120 seconds. Existing successful response shapes are unchanged. Mixed client/server versions are not independently qualified.

downtime.detail: Requires the normal daemon binary restart. Restart-to-API and restart-to-health duration have not been measured for this change.

manual.detail: No setting, store repair or identity migration is required.

recovery.detail: No on-disk migration. A binary rollback restores prior read behavior; it does not repair a slow read.
